content:
铁砧没有昂贵的限制且兼容任何附魔。

配置

该模组使用MineConf进行配置。

配置项

配置 描述
max_level 最大修复等级（默认值：39）。设为0则自动计算。
combine_higher 是否合并高级附魔（默认值：false）。
compatibility 允许两种附魔互相兼容。 
{
  "maxLevel": 39,
  "combineHigher": false,
  "compatibility": {
    "minecraft:mending": [
      "minecraft:infinity"
    ],
    "minecraft:multishot": [
      "minecraft:piercing"
    ],
    "minecraft:sharpness": [
      "minecraft:smite",
      "minecraft:bane_of_arthropods"
    ],
    "minecraft:smite": [
      "minecraft:bane_of_arthropods",
      "minecraft:sharpness"
    ],
    "minecraft:bane_of_arthropods": [
      "minecraft:sharpness",
      "minecraft:smite"
    ],
    "minecraft:density": [
      "minecraft:breach",
      "minecraft:sharpness",
      "minecraft:smite",
      "minecraft:bane_of_arthropods"
    ],
    "minecraft:breach": [
      "minecraft:density",
      "minecraft:sharpness",
      "minecraft:smite",
      "minecraft:bane_of_arthropods"
    ],
    "minecraft:protection": [
      "minecraft:projectile_protection",
      "minecraft:blast_protection",
      "minecraft:fire_protection"
    ],
    "minecraft:projectile_protection": [
      "minecraft:blast_protection",
      "minecraft:fire_protection",
      "minecraft:protection"
    ],
    "minecraft:blast_protection": [
      "minecraft:fire_protection",
      "minecraft:protection",
      "minecraft:projectile_protection"
    ],
    "minecraft:fire_protection": [
      "minecraft:protection",
      "minecraft:projectile_protection",
      "minecraft:blast_protection"
    ]
  }
}

旧版本说明

  • Compatibility配置中使用的是数字（附魔ID）而非字符串（附魔名称），因为1.7.x及以下版本中附魔是通过数字注册的。
